description: Defines classes and interfaces for OpenGL query objects within the ANGLE project, including QueryGL, StandardQueryGL, and SyncQueryGL, along with their methods and internal state management.

classes.name: QueryGL
classes.description: Abstract base class for OpenGL query objects, providing interface for pause and resume operations.

classes.name: StandardQueryGL
classes.description: Implements standard OpenGL query functionality, managing active and pending queries, and retrieving results.

classes.name: SyncQueryGL
classes.description: Implements synchronized OpenGL query functionality, supporting supported features and result retrieval.

methods.name: QueryGL
methods.description: Constructor for QueryGL, initializes query with specified type.

methods.name: ~QueryGL
methods.description: Destructor for QueryGL.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the query, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the query, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: StandardQueryGL
methods.description: Constructor for StandardQueryGL, initializes with query type, functions, and state manager.

methods.name: ~StandardQueryGL
methods.description: Destructor for StandardQueryGL.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts the query operation.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the query operation.

methods.name: queryCounter
methods.description: Records a query counter.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the query result in various data types.

methods.name: isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the query result is available.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes pending queries, implementation detail.

methods.name: getResultBase
methods.description: Template method to get the result in a specific type.

methods.name: SyncQueryGL
methods.description: Constructor for SyncQueryGL, initializes with query type and functions.

methods.name: ~SyncQueryGL
methods.description: Destructor for SyncQueryGL.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if sync queries are supported with given functions.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts the sync query.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the sync query.

methods.name: queryCounter
methods.description: Records a query counter for sync query.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the sync query.

methods.name: isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the sync query result is available.
